title: Universaarl Company Information setup decision and guarded value fit
goal: Prepare and, if the gate is clear, set the first Company Information values for Universaarl GmbH in UNIVERSAARL-DE with before/after screenshots.
mustCheckBeforeRun: Role Center header or equivalent shell context shows UNIVERSAARL-DE
Company Information / Firmendaten opens under company=UNIVERSAARL-DE
Exact value set for Universaarl GmbH is documented before entry
Before screenshot exists before any setup value is changed
successCriteria: Company Information values are either saved with before/after proof or the run stops before changing values.
No posting, preview posting, document creation or master data creation occurs.
The result clearly states which fields were set and which remain open.
The next Foundation setup step is derived from the observed state, not guessed.
nextSafeAction: Run TARGET-012 W1 Foundation readiness; do not claim posting readiness from Company Information alone.

smartDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-010 proved UNIVERSAARL-DE context and Company Information read-only. TARGET-011 targets only the known legal name value.
smartDecisionCard.reason: The first Company Information value is now visible; the next step is to decide the remaining W1 Foundation setup sequence.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Name is set; remaining foundation setup can be scoped deliberately.
Number series and posting groups follow W1 readiness.
Dimensions can be planned after W1 readiness decides setup order.
Master data planning can continue, but data creation waits for setup gates.
Look-and-feel final screenshots need meaningful Universaarl data.

smartDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: A W1 readiness gate prevents random setup changes and orders number series, posting groups, VAT and dimensions.
risksBeforeNextCase: Address, country/region and VAT values are still not approved.
No later process should claim posting readiness from Company Information alone.
requiredPreparation: Define W1 Foundation order and decide which remaining Company Information fields can be filled safely.

proved: Company Information / Firmendaten opened in playthru under company=UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Name was already visible as Universaarl GmbH; no additional value entry was needed.
After reopening the page, Universaarl GmbH was visible in Company Information.
No posting, preview, document, master data, API or search route was used.
openLimits: Address, VAT Registration No., bank information and communication details remain open.
Number Series, Posting Groups, VAT setup, Dimensions, master data, preview and posting readiness are not proven.
This is a Foundation setup step, not a ledger or process proof.
